notices.short_title: First Amendment to the M/WBE Contractor Agreement for Labor and Materials for On-Call Painting Service

notices.description: The New York City Department of Correction (NYCDOC) seeks a qualified M/WBE-certified vendor to develop and implement a comprehensive integration of the Departments existing Programmable Logic Controller (PLC)based jail control panels with the Genetec Security Center platform. The project encompasses two independent cell wings, each containing 48 inmate cells and 4 auxiliary rooms (totaling 104 access points across both wings). Each wing operates using its own PLC hardware and wiring infrastructure, which must be integrated into DOCs unified Genetec security ecosystem for centralized command, monitoring, automation, and video-assisted situational awareness. This modernization initiative aims to replace manual, panel-based workflows with automated, rules-driven functionality, enhancing operator efficiency, reducing human error, and improving DOCs ability to escalate, track, and respond to security-critical events in real time

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN THAT THE NEW YORK CITY RENT GUIDELINES BOARD (RGB) will hold a public hearing on June 8, 2026 at the Main Theatre of Hostos Community College/CUNY, 450 Grand Concourse, Bronx, NY from 5:00 P.M. to 8:00 P.M to consider public comments concerning proposed rent adjustments on leases for apartments, lofts, hotels (including class A and class B hotels, SROs, rooming houses and lodging houses) and other housing units subject to the Rent Stabilization Law of 1969 and the Emergency Tenant Protection Act of 1974. These adjustments will affect leases commencing between October 1, 2026 through September 30, 2027. 

Proposed rent guidelines for all of the above classes of stabilized housing units were adopted on May 7, 2026. Copies of the proposed guidelines are available from the NYC Rent Guidelines Board office at the above listed address, at the Boards website nyc.gov/rgb, or at rules.cityofnewyork.us.
